title: Settlement — faction presence
_note: Phase 9.5 Settlement-situation oracle: an extra note when a faction HOLDS or borders the hex, colouring the town with that power's presence. {faction} is replaced with the faction's full name by the engine — names carry their own article/form ("The Ashen Hand", "Adders of the Reach", "House Umber"), so every template keeps {faction} as the object of a preposition to stay grammatical (no doubled "the", no possessive). Full sentences with terminal punctuation. All weight 1.

entries.value: Recruiters for {faction} work the square.
Banners of {faction} hang from the walls.
A checkpoint turns strangers away in the name of {faction}.
Informers loyal to {faction} are everywhere — speak carefully.
Tolls have been raised on the orders of {faction}.
Able hands are being conscripted for {faction}.
Patrols under {faction} keep a heavy presence.
Whispers say the grip of {faction} is slipping here.
A magistrate installed by {faction} now holds court.
Tribute owed to {faction} is overdue, and tempers with it.
Grain and coin buy loyalty for {faction}.
Locals mutter against {faction} behind closed doors.
An agent of {faction} watches the comings and goings.
Gatherings after dark are forbidden by {faction}.
Deserters from {faction} are being hunted here.
The town is being fortified for {faction} against a rival.
The shrine has been rededicated to {faction}.
New arrivals must register with the agents of {faction}.
A price hangs over anyone who speaks against {faction}.
The gallows stand ready for enemies of {faction}.
Trade here runs only with the blessing of {faction}.
Children are being schooled in the creed of {faction}.
Oaths of service to {faction} are demanded at the gate.
Bells are rung each dusk in honour of {faction}.
